title: Research: exclude four P112 profiles with simplex support budgets
body:
## Summary

Prove four additional characteristic-zero P112 TWOSIDE exclusions: `3,5^2,6^(b+1)` and `4^2,5,6^(b+1)`, for `b=6,7`, `t=4`.

```text
                         required endpoint support > allowance
Seven-vertex simplex:               145 > 140
Eight-vertex simplex:               166 > 160
```

The new count uses the most frequent coordinate evaluation after a common shift. A complete small stabilizer-reflection enumeration retains one rank-six star and both rank-seven branches. Allowing 36 arbitrary deleted lines still gives contradiction margins `5,5,6,6`.

Only `research/p112-simplex-support-budget/` is added. It includes the [proof](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2393963d835a60b8524e986b969c8a87b26a07e3/research/p112-simplex-support-budget/PROOF.md), exact sources, receipt, registered replay and controls. Commit `2393963d835a60b8524e986b969c8a87b26a07e3`; canonical main `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`, priority revision 6. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-18999814).

Credit DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 and its decoder lineage, Nick Petalas/PR3164 for retained geometry, PR3170 for larger simplices, and PR3169/3173 for the previous coordinate count. The sixteen-cut/no-anchor weight audit distinguishes the earlier deletion bounds. Existing support overlap could give other covers; no completeness claim about all prior proofs is made.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3173's coordinate count has margins `-7,-8` on these profiles. **After:** exact support spectra give margins `5,6` for each pair of profiles, with quotient cap `48<53` and edge cap `68<70`.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay and fourteen behavioral groups pass. All 4,097,782 finite flat kernels, complete stabilizer partitions, original survivor inclusion and exact receipts are checked.
- Optimized Python 3.13, read-only Git-free export, final committed export, strict warnings, lint, seven retained-source origin comparisons and all nineteen publication-byte comparisons pass locally.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-simplex-support-budget
```

This is a written proof with finite evidence, not full C5, `C(P112)>=64`, supplier admission or a new kappa. The standard Weyl-chamber theorem and the original reduction remain inherited dependencies. Development and checking used automated assistance; independent human/proof-kernel review and hosted CI are separate. Open next questions are in the README and task metadata.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast radius:** research.

One isolated opt-in package. No selected-frontier, shared-runner or frozen-source changes.
